usage: 動物 is a noun that refers to animals, living creatures other than humans.
You can use 動物 to talk about animals in general or specific types of animals.
動物 often appears in conversations about pets, wildlife, zoos, and nature.
It can be combined with other words to specify types of animals, like 野生動物 (wild animals) or 水生動物 (aquatic animals).
